Responsibility: `objectui's record page re-filters a row the approvals door already served against the data door's /auth/me/permissions answer` | `the approvals routes (GET /approvals/requests/:id and /actions) already apply the request read gate server-side; nothing on the client path honours that` | `every non-admin approver reaches it from the account app's Approvals inbox today; 18.1.0 would ship it`
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: none (open objectui PRs read at claim time: none touches `packages/permissions/src/`, `AppContent.tsx` or `approvalRequestsDataSource*`; the release PR touches only `packages/permissions/CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json`)

Plan, stated so the review can hold it to it: the console already routes a request's `findOne` and its timeline read to the approvals routes for every record surface below `ApprovalRecordReads`. The same provider will also scope the client's field-READ gate for `sys_approval_request` and `sys_approval_action` to the server that served the rows, so `withoutDeniedFields` and every `checkField(..., 'read')` fold stop stripping a row the door already filtered. Write/create verdicts, object verdicts and every other object keep the enclosing `/auth/me/permissions` answer. ⛔ No change asks objectstack to grant read on either object. `Clause-②: yes` because the scope is a new export of `@object-ui/permissions`. The pin renders the served page under a real `MePermissionsProvider` whose answer omits both objects.
